narr: In an environment characterized by PWAT values of around 1.5 with MLCAPE values near 1000 J/KG, thunderstorm activity developed across the Mohave Desert during the early afternoon hours. An isolated strong thunderstorm developed over the higher terrain area of Joshua Tree National Park, where it remained anchored and dumped over an inch of rain in less than one hour, enough rainfall in a short time span to cause road closures due to flooding.
ev: Roads along the Indian Cove Campground Site in Joshua Tree National Park closed due to flooding. No damages nor injuries were reported.
lsr: Joshua Tree National Park Service reports flooding at State Route 62 and National Park Drive.
Morongo Valley Sheriff reports Split Rock Ave and Tamarisk Ave and Ocotillo Ave closed due to flooding.
Roads along the Indian Cove Campground Site closed due to flooding.
Kelbaker Road was closed from Interstate 40 to Kelso Depot due to flash flooding and debris flow. The road remained closed on July 24th for debris removal and should be open on July 25th.
